- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips to save money on groceries:

  2. Shop sales and stock up.
  3. Buy in bulk.
  4. Shop at discount stores or Aldi.
  5. Use cashback apps like Ibotta and Fetch Rewards.
  6. Avoid processed and pre-packaged foods.
  7. Shop in season.
  8. Use unit prices to compare items.
  9. Don't shop when hungry.
  10. Review and adjust spending regularly.
